tasks.name: m1-cockpit
tasks.scopedGoal: Own milestone M1 (Read-only cockpit) end-to-end per AUTONOMY_BRIEF.md and PLAN.md §12 M1. Scaffold the Tauri v2 + Svelte 5 + TS + Vite + Rust app from scratch and ship a working read-only PR cockpit on a single deliverable branch. Read AUTONOMY_BRIEF.md, PLAN.md, synthesis.md (in the repo root) and DECISIONS.md before planning; PLAN.md is the contract. Decompose into your own workers/subplanners; default to fewer, broader workers; merges are tasks. M1 deliverables, in order of fan-in: (1) Bootstrap: Tauri v2 + Svelte 5 + TS + Vite + SvelteKit static adapter; Rust crate with sqlx, keyring, octocrab (or hand-rolled reqwest), comrak, ammonia, tree-sitter wasm, notify, git2, specta, tokio, tracing, anyhow; Primer CSS (@primer/css + @primer/primitives + @primer/octicons) wired; pnpm workspace; GitHub Actions CI on ubuntu + macos covering rust fmt/clippy/test, typescript typecheck + svelte-check, unit and integration tests, a headless perf benchmark stub (criterion + a synthetic timing harness), and a markdown corpus regression stub; conventional commits + commitlint optional. (2) Auth: detect `gh auth token` for one-click import with explicit scope display; OAuth Device Flow (client_id from DECISIONS.md) as default for new users; PAT fallback; multi-account from day one; tokens in OS keychain only via `keyring`. (3) Sync engine v1: tiered focus-aware polling actor per PLAN.md §2.1 (Hot/Warm/Cool/Cold, paused after 5 min unfocus), rate-limit budgeter actor parsing X-RateLimit-* with high-priority foreground lane and back-pressure under 1000 GraphQL points / 500 REST, REST .diff fetch with Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.diff, conditional ETag/If-None-Match path, /notifications change-detector with If-Modified-Since and X-Poll-Interval. (4) Two canonical GraphQL queries: hand-written, centrally-owned `PrDetail` (title/body/timeline/threads/reviews/check summary/labels/assignees/reviewers/mergeable/headRef/baseRef) and thin `InboxRefresh` batching ~20 PR node IDs; no per-component GraphQL. (5) SQLite migrations covering tables in PLAN.md §4 (accounts, repos, repo_subscriptions, users, orgs, pull_requests, pr_labels/assignees/reviewers/projects/milestones, commits/pr_commits, comments, review_threads, reviews, check_suites/runs/annotations, pr_files, pr_patches, notifications, worktrees, pending_mutations, id_mappings, sync_cursors, rate_limit_buckets, blob_refs) + denormalized read models (pr_inbox_rows, pr_detail_summary, unread_counts, file_tree_summary) + FTS5 virtual tables; content-addressed blob store under app data dir (`blobs/<sha256-prefix>/<sha256>`) with zstd-compressed patches. (6) IPC + types: Tauri commands for queries; Tauri events for cache invalidations (`pr:123 changed`); specta-generated Rust → TS types so the renderer never opens SQLite or talks to GitHub directly. (7) Svelte 5 frontend (`$state`/`$derived`/`$effect`): inbox view served from `pr_inbox_rows` rendered from SQLite synchronously on cold start; PR detail with description, timeline, labels, reviewers, checks; side-by-side + unified diff view backed by a custom virtualized line component on @tanstack/svelte-virtual; per-line review thread anchoring using GitHub's `line`/`side`/`start_line`/`start_side` verbatim; tree-sitter wasm highlighting in a Web Worker, lazy by viewport, hard cap above 5k lines unless opted-in, token cache keyed by (language, content_hash). (8) Comrak markdown pipeline in Rust + ammonia sanitization + custom post-processors for GitHub extras (alerts, suggestion fences, @user/#123/SHA autolinks); render is cached by (content_hash, renderer_version) in the blob store; the textarea + Preview tab in the composer (not implemented in M1 but the renderer must exist for timeline rendering). (9) Markdown corpus regression: pull ~200 real comments via API on a public-repo corpus, render through comrak + post-processors, score against github.com's served HTML (use GitHub's markdown REST endpoint as oracle); CI must enforce ≤ 2% pixel-diff or equivalent text-diff metric. (10) Perf benchmark harness: enforces PLAN.md §10 budgets (inbox first paint <100 ms warm cache; PR detail open preloaded <50 ms / cold cache hit <250 ms; file open in diff cached <100 ms; diff scroll 60 fps on ≤ 5k-line diff); CI runs against WebKitGTK Linux specifically. (11) Token safety: keychain only, never SQLite, never logs (verified by a targeted test). M1 acceptance is met when the app boots offline against pre-seeded SQLite fixtures (a worker should also wire a happy-path online demo against a public repo using a CI-provided GITHUB_TOKEN if one is available, but it must not block M1 if not), the cold-start inbox paints under 100 ms on the bench, the diff renders 5k-line PRs at 60 fps in the scroll benchmark, and the markdown corpus regression passes ≤ 2%. Commit the final deliverable to your subplanner bookkeeping branch (the placeholder `orch/pr-cockpit/m1-cockpit`); the parent will use that branch as the starting ref for M2. Do not open a PR — the parent decides shipping. Read AUTONOMY_BRIEF.md §M1 and PLAN.md §12 M1 verbatim into your subplanner plan.json as `acceptanceCriteria`.
